title_zh: 微笑的拓扑学：牙科影像中的持续同调
title_en: Topology of a Smile: Persistent Homology in Dental Imaging
summary_zh: 锥束CT（CBCT）扫描提供详细的三维图像，广泛应用于牙科诊断和治疗规划。尽管价值巨大，分析和记录这些扫描通常耗时耗力，因此自动化关键步骤如解剖结构的分类与分割变得重要。本文提出利用持续同调的拓扑数据分析方法，通过识别多尺度下的数据形态特征（连通组件、洞和空腔）结合支持向量机，实现对CBCT扫描牙齿的分类和诊断。该方法在牙齿标记和诊断任务中分别达到97.67%和96.77%的平均准确率，显著优于训练相同数据的卷积神经网络(CNN)的70.27%和86.67%。
summary_en: Cone Beam Computed Tomography (CBCT) scans offer detailed 3D images widely used in dental diagnostics and treatment planning. Analyzing these scans is laborious, prompting automation efforts for key steps like anatomical classification and segmentation to identify teeth and related pathologies. This article proposes an approach using persistent homology from topological data analysis, which studies data shape by detecting features such as connected components, holes, and voids across multiple scales. Combined with a support vector machine, this method classifies teeth in CBCT scans and performs diagnostics, achieving average accuracies of 97.67% for tooth labeling and 96.77% for diagnostics, outperforming a CNN trained on the same data with accuracies of 70.27% and 86.67%, respectively.
why_it_matters_zh: 本研究展示了拓扑数据分析特别是持续同调技术在医疗影像自动化中的潜力，通过研究数据形态的多层次特征实现高精度牙齿分类与诊断，显著提升了自动化分析的准确率和效率，推动了牙科影像处理技术的进步。
why_it_matters_en: This study demonstrates the potential of topological data analysis, specifically persistent homology, in automating medical imaging tasks. By capturing multi-scale shape features of data, it achieves high-accuracy tooth classification and diagnostics, significantly improving automation accuracy and efficiency and advancing dental image processing technologies.

title_zh: EditStream：一个用于交互式视频生成和编辑的统一自回归框架
title_en: EditStream: A Unified Autoregressive Framework for Interactive Video Generation and Editing
summary_zh: EditStream是一种统一的框架，支持交互式视频生成和编辑。该框架基于DiT模型，通过灵活的任务特定条件，整合了文本到视频、图像到视频、视频到视频、编辑传播、参考引导视频编辑及相机姿态变换等多种视频创建与操作任务。通过结合速度矩匹配（VMM）和自回归展开的两阶段蒸馏方法，EditStream实现了快速、少步的自回归生成，提升了视频质量和运动表现的稳定性，解决了过饱和、运动退化和时间不稳定等常见问题，提供了一个适合交互式创意流程的实用且可扩展的解决方案。
summary_en: EditStream is a unified framework for interactive video generation and editing based on a DiT model, integrating multiple tasks such as Text-to-Video, Image-to-Video, Video-to-Video, Editing Propagation, Reference-guided Video Editing, and Camera Pose Change through flexible conditioning. It introduces a two-stage distillation approach combining Velocity Moment Matching (VMM) and autoregressive unrolling to enable fast, few-step autoregressive generation, improving video quality, motion fidelity, and temporal stability while addressing issues like over-saturation and motion degradation. EditStream offers a practical and scalable solution bridging high-quality diffusion-based video models with interactive creative workflows.
why_it_matters_zh: 随着创意设计对视频生成和编辑的需求增加，EditStream通过统一模型和高效自回归方法，简化了多任务视频操作流程，显著提升了交互式视频制作的效率和质量，推动了视频AI技术在实际创作中的应用。
why_it_matters_en: As demands grow for creative video generation and editing, EditStream simplifies multi-task video operations within a unified model and efficient autoregressive approach, significantly enhancing the efficiency and quality of interactive video production, thereby advancing the application of video AI technology in real-world creative workflows.

title_zh: 评估流行好莱坞电影的多模态叙事理解能力
title_en: Evaluating Multimodal Narrative Understanding of Popular Hollywood Films
summary_zh: 多模态语言模型在大规模电影计算分析中展现出潜力，有助于研究电影历史和叙事技巧演变。但版权保护使构建基于好莱坞电影的稳定基准复杂化。本文通过建立一个基于票房流行度和公共领域状态的好莱坞电影合集，发布了1922至1979年《Variety》周票房数据，并构建了一个多模态选择题基准评估模型叙事元素理解能力。实验发现许多视觉语言模型表现近似随机，音频视觉模型最高准确率为61.1%，仍远低于人类水平。
summary_en: Multimodal language models show promise for large-scale computational film analysis, aiding the study of film history and narrative evolution. However, copyright issues complicate stable benchmarks based on Hollywood films. This work creates a new Hollywood film collection defined by box office popularity and likely public domain status, including the first large-scale open dataset of weekly box office earnings from 1922-1979 sourced from Variety magazine. A new multimodal multiple-choice benchmark focusing on narrative elements is built on this collection. Results show many vision-language models struggle, performing near chance, while audio-visual models achieve a maximum accuracy of 61.1%, which is well below human performance.
why_it_matters_zh: 该研究解决版权保护障碍，首次公开历史票房数据，系统评估多模态模型对电影叙事理解的能力，揭示当前模型尚未达到人类水平，推动电影人工智能研究发展。
why_it_matters_en: This work overcomes copyright barriers by releasing historical box office data and systematically evaluates multimodal models' abilities in film narrative understanding. It reveals current models fall short of human performance, thereby advancing AI research in film analysis.

title_zh: PUMA：面向文化背景的波兰语多模态理解基准
title_en: PUMA: A Polish Benchmark for Culturally Grounded Multimodal Understanding
summary_zh: 大型语言模型正逐步超越纯文本处理，增加对图像和音频等多模态数据的支持。本文提出PUMA（波兰统一多模态评估），包含900个人工设计任务，专门测试模型在波兰文化与语言背景下的多模态能力，涵盖文本、图像、音频及视觉丰富文档的理解与处理。评测显示顶级商用模型在视觉问答表现优异，但多数模型在复杂音频和文档理解上表现不足。团队开源了评测框架推动本地化多模态AI研究发展。
summary_en: Large language models are expanding beyond text to support multimodal data like images and audio. This paper introduces PUMA (Polish Unified Multimodal Assessment), a benchmark of 900 handcrafted tasks designed to probe multimodal models' capabilities in the Polish cultural and linguistic context, covering text, images, audio, and visually rich documents. Evaluation reveals top commercial models excel in visual question answering, whereas many models struggle with complex audio or document understanding. The authors open-source their evaluation framework to foster localized multimodal AI research.
why_it_matters_zh: PUMA基准填补了多模态理解在非英语文化语境中的评测空白，促进了多模态AI在不同语言文化环境下的发展和应用。
why_it_matters_en: PUMA addresses the lack of comprehensive multimodal evaluation benchmarks for non-English cultural contexts, promoting the development and application of multimodal AI across diverse languages and cultures.

title_zh: 追逐即课程，捕获定信用：基于追逃自我对弈的零数据大语言模型推理
title_en: The Chase Is the Curriculum, the Capture Anchors the Credit: Pursuit-Evasion Self-Play for Zero-Data LLM Reasoning
summary_zh: 在大语言模型推理中，带有可验证奖励的强化学习已成主流，但依赖大量人工任务集合。零数据自我对弈突破此限制，LURE通过将自我对弈重塑为追逃游戏，令模型根据环境难度轴动态设置任务，实现学习式定位任务难度，并通过捕获前沿奖励和锚定捕获的密集过程奖励，提升任务解决能力。该方法在多个推理环境和模型架构中表现优越，且在零样本迁移任务上取得更强泛化效果。
summary_en: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards improves large language model reasoning but requires human-curated tasks. The zero-data self-play approach LURE models this as a pursuit-evasion game where an evader LLM strategically positions tasks by difficulty to stay ahead of a pursuer solver. Using a capture-frontier reward and capture-anchored dense credit, LURE learns task difficulty placement and stable co-evolution, outperforming baselines across multiple reasoning environments and achieving stronger zero-shot out-of-distribution accuracy on held-out benchmarks.
why_it_matters_zh: 该研究提出创新的零数据自我对弈框架，通过追逃博弈视角实现任务难度的动态学习和高效奖励设计，提升了LLM推理能力并增强泛化性能，推动了无需大量人工标注数据的智能推理技术发展。
why_it_matters_en: This work introduces an innovative zero-data self-play mechanism framing reasoning as a pursuit-evasion game, enabling dynamic task difficulty learning and effective reward structuring. It advances LLM reasoning capabilities and generalization, promoting progress in data-efficient intelligent reasoning without reliance on extensive human annotation.
